headline: Maersk Upgrades 2026 Profit Outlook on Strong Freight Rates and Resilient Demand
summary: Maersk upgraded its 2026 profit outlook for a third time, citing port congestion, resilient consumer demand, and investments in artificial intelligence. The announcement comes alongside trading volatility in its shares.
why: A.P. Moller-Maersk is one of the world's largest container shipping companies, making its guidance a critical proxy for global trade volumes and supply chain health.

impacts.name: A.P. Møller - Mærsk A/S
impacts.why: Maersk raised full-year profit guidance while its equity faced market volatility during intraday trading.
